definitions.explanation: The outdoor area of a school used for physical education, recess, and other activities.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちが{校庭|こうてい}で{遊|あそ}んでいる。
examples.english: The children are playing in the schoolyard.

examples.japanese: {校庭|こうてい}で{運動会|うんどうかい}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: A sports day was held in the schoolyard.

examples.japanese: {校庭|こうてい}は{広|ひろ}くて{緑|みどり}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: The schoolyard is spacious with lots of greenery.

notes:
COMPONENTS:
・{校|こう} (school) + {庭|てい} (yard, garden)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{校庭|こうてい}で{遊|あそ}ぶ (to play in the schoolyard)
・{校庭|こうてい}を{走|はし}る (to run in the schoolyard)
